name: Pro Planet P3
summary: Powered with the path-breaking RO+Silver Charged Membrane Technology, ProPlanet P3 gives you 100% RO purified, Baby-Safe water, thanks to its 8-stage purification process.
intro: The A. O. Smith ProPlanet P3 is a premium 100% RO water purifier featuring 8-stage purification with RO + Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) for Baby-Safe drinking water. Equipped with Advanced Recovery Technology™, it saves 2X more water than conventional RO purifiers while enriching water with essential minerals through Alkaline Min-Tech. With a 5L storage tank, digital Intelli-Display, and support for borewell, tanker, and mixed water sources, the ProPlanet P3 delivers safe, healthy, and great-tasting water every day.
features: Alkaline Min-Tech, Digital Intelli-Display, Night Assist, 5-Star Water Saving, Advanced Recovery Technology™
